script.speaker: student
script.text: Hi. I am trying to reserve a group study room for Thursday afternoon, but the booking page says I am not allowed to continue.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Let me check. Are you trying to book it for yourself or for a study group? The small rooms are only available to groups of at least three students.

script.speaker: student
script.text: There will be four of us. We have a presentation on Friday, so we need a screen and enough space to practise together.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That should be fine. The problem may be the length of your booking. Students can reserve a room for a maximum of two hours per day.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I selected one o'clock until four. I did not realise there was a limit. If I change it to two hours, will the system accept it?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Probably, but there is one more condition. Reservations open exactly three days in advance. Today is Monday, so you can book Thursday now, but not Friday yet.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I see. I will choose two until four on Thursday. Do all the rooms have a screen?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Rooms G12 and G14 do. G10 only has a whiteboard. G12 is already full, but G14 is free during the time you want.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Great. Is there anything we need to bring?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Bring one student card to open the door. Also, check in on the booking page within fifteen minutes of the starting time. Otherwise, the room becomes available to other students.

script.speaker: student
script.text: All right. I will change the length, choose G14, and remind everyone not to be late. Thanks for explaining it.

questions.stem: Why does the student want to reserve a room?
questions.rationale: The student says the group needs space and a screen to practise a presentation.

questions.stem: What caused the first booking problem?

options.C: The requested period was too long
options.D: The student had no library card

questions.rationale: The student selected three hours, but the daily maximum is two hours.

questions.stem: Which room should the student choose?
questions.rationale: G14 has a screen and is available from two until four.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about checking in?

options.A: It protects the booking from being cancelled
options.B: It must be completed three days earlier
options.C: Every group member must use a card
options.D: It is only required in room G12

questions.rationale: Without checking in within fifteen minutes, the room is released to other students.
